Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
2. Heard Sri Brajesh Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Smt. Priyanka, with the prayer to direct the Judicial Magistrate Konch, Jalaun to decide Complaint Case No. 785 of 2016,
Smt. Priyanka vs. Vikas Patel, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.-
Konch, District Jalaun.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the trial is of the year 2016.

It is argued that delay Smt. Priyanka vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35997687/
1 in disposal of the said case is causing irreparable loss and hardship to the applicant and as such appropriate direction be issued for disposal of trial in time bound manner.

entities.text: Smt. Priyanka vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned State counsel opposed the prayer made in the present matter by arguing that no such specific reasons have been made out for giving any direction for expediting the trial of the case and as such the application be dismissed.
6. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the trial is of the year 2016.
The same as per order sheet is going on.
There is no specific reason for expediting the same.

However, the applicant who is complainant of the case, may file an application for expediting the trial of the case before the court concerned within two weeks from today, which may as per its load of work, diary and pendency of cases, pass appropriate orders on the same within two weeks thereafter.
7. It is made clear that this Court has not passed any direction for expediting the trial.
8. The present application is disposed of.
